name: Pes Cavus / Cavovarus Foot
definition: High-arched foot deformity, often with hindfoot varus, that may be idiopathic or associated with hereditary/neurological disease.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs assess alignment; neurological workup is required if progression or weakness is present.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Rigid painful deformity may require reconstructive surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-vikriti may be documented; neurological cause must remain explicit.

patientEducation.summary: High-arched foot deformity, often with hindfoot varus, that may be idiopathic or associated with hereditary/neurological disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
